ablation.name: phase4i5c_sota_heun_rquad_5ep
ablation.notes: Phase 4I.5c: rquad schedule + Heun + 5ep. rquad: t=horizon*(1-(1-i/steps)^2) — slow at END (near target/style distribution). Bias toward style transfer (opposite of cosine's content bias). Goal: recover clip while keeping lpips gains. Map the schedule-shape Pareto frontier: cosine (content) vs linear (neutral) vs rquad (style). If rquad gives clip > 0.7266 with lpips < 0.3229, schedule shape breaks Pareto in BOTH directions.
